fn main(argc:i32, argv:**u8)->i32 {
    if argc == 2i32 && c_equal(argv[1usize], "--help") {
        var text:*u8 = "usage: rmd-resource [--check | --prepare | --emit-c | --object]\n                    [--library | --entry NAME] [-o OUTPUT] [--symbols RESPONSEFILE]\n                    [--cflag ARG] [--ldflag ARG] [--export NAME] SOURCE...\n";
        if rmd0_host_write_stream(1u32, text, c_length(text)) == 0i32 { return 0i32; }
        c_driver_stderr("rmd-resource: cannot write standard output\n");
        return 1i32;
    }
    if argc == 2i32 && c_equal(argv[1usize], "--version") {
        var text:*u8 = "rmd-resource (RMD0 resource stage, Linux x86-64 LP64)\n";
        if rmd0_host_write_stream(1u32, text, c_length(text)) == 0i32 { return 0i32; }
        c_driver_stderr("rmd-resource: cannot write standard output\n");
        return 1i32;
    }
    var context:RmdContext = uninit;
    rmd_context_init(&context, null(*RmdAllocator));
    var request:RmdBuild = make RmdBuild {
        context:&context, source:null(*RmdSource), target_begin:0usize,
        argc:argc - 1i32, argv:argv + 1isize
    };
    var result:i32 = resource_program(&request);
    if context.error_count != 0usize { c_driver_diagnostic(&context); }
    rmd_context_destroy(&context);
    return result;
}
